history.event: Claude refinement: 24 line(s) suggested — Corrected Kraken letter confusions (L/R, e/o, b/l, v/n, t/l) that garbled words such as frati, loro, trebiano, vigne, pichole, beni, ebbi, tucte, botti, vendemmia, pigionale and giovanni; added missing suspension marks (p̄mo, an̄o); restored the 1465 date; replaced the ⫳ carried over from another manuscript with this manuscript's lira sign 𝓎 (lire xxvii = 𝓎 27). | layout: l1: the box covers only '5.' of the page date '1465.' at the head of the page; widen it to take in '146'; l2: the initial R of 'Ricordo' is outside the box (Kraken read 'Licordo'); l6: the first word is only partly read (nel/nella …), so it may run past the left edge of the box; l24: this is the sum for the first entry, on the same line as l13 (after the ruled dash); it sits in its own box | doubts: l3: 'ßuj' after 'frati di': probably an abbreviation of Servi (Servite friars), but the abbreviation sign is unclear; l4: the last word (place name) could be da lucernaglio or daluernuglio; l6: the first word could be nella corte, nel castello or nella parrocchia; the image is too cursive to decide; l7/l8: 'edauē | demie' is read as e da vendemmie split over two lines (compare 'lavēdemia' in l21); the l7 ending is uncertain; l16: the words after 'ebbi la' are illegible to me (Kraken 'lui latone'); l18: 'ꝑ ch nō' is a guess for Kraken 'ꝓ cs ar̄o'; l22: 'tenene' (or tenne/teneva?) and the name after ß (vincenzo?) are unclear; l24: lira sign changed from ⫳ to 𝓎 following CONVENTIONS.md (lira = 𝓎, not ⫳); the written glyph looks like a crossed double stroke, so Laura should confirm
